## Checklist

- [ ] `dagger check -m .dagger` passes locally (see [Verifying your change](https://github.com/Neirda24/envoke/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#verifying-your-change))
- [ ] New behavior has test coverage (table-driven, `Test<Func>_<Scenario>` naming)
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes user-facing behavior (`docs/`, `README.md`)
- [ ] PR is scoped to a single capability or fix — no unrelated cleanup bundled in
